name: Ophelia
source:
Ophelia’s honesty is almost a fault. Her delivery completely lacks tact, and she really doesn’t care. In fact, she cares so little about what others think about her behavior that often she comes across as mean and nasty. Still, while working with Lucien, she speaks her mind to the MC, and makes sure to note that her coworker does not give anyone this same courtesy. In this way, Ophelia is meant to be a foil to Lucien’s behavior.

Ophelia’s past is shrouded in mystery, and she doesn’t offer much information about her personal life to the MC. She holds her job in very high esteem and doesn’t bother to muddle her work with emotional turmoil or sappy personal stories.

[From strategy guide]
